candidateSelection: Highest grouped OOF balanced accuracy at 0.5, then F1, then smaller C
thresholdSelection: Validation balanced accuracy, then F1, then closest to 0.5
deployment: Mean probability of three fold checkpoints; no full-training refit
features: Source-only heuristic statement graphs with def/use edges, operator/type/storage/rounding comparisons; no labels, IDs, test outcomes, provided alignments, rationale or variant order
localizationSupervision: Training-only synthetic defect segment annotations; candidate correspondence source-derived
testPolicy: Freeze artifact and SHA256 first; separate explicit command; final-test marker refuses repeated assessment
baseline: Constant no-defect and training-only selected source graph distance threshold
dataQualityDisclosure: Validation/test source and labels already inspected for generated-data quality; no model has been fitted or selected. Do not call this a pristine blind benchmark.
